rules.title: Annual Rent Increase Based on CPI-U
rules.requirement: Landlords may increase rent annually based on the monthly Consumer Price Index-Urban percentage (CPI-U %) published every month, provided proper written notice is given.

coverage.summary: Applies to residential rental units in Newark subject to rent control, excluding public housing, hotels/motels, commercial spaces, and validly certified newly constructed or substantially rehabilitated exempt dwellings.

rules.exemptions: Public housing, motel or hotel space rented day-to-day, commercial use, and properly certified newly constructed or substantially rehabilitated dwellings.
